text: とおで　するなら　げんきのかけらは　かっといた　ほうが　いいわ

structure.en: if you're going on a long trip

structure.jp: かっといた　ほうが　いいわ

patterns.name: 〜たほうがいい
patterns.span: かっといた　ほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb plus ほうがいい gives advice: 'you'd better'. かっといた ほうが いい = 'you'd better buy them beforehand'.

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: ておく after a verb says you do it ahead of time to be ready; とく is the short spoken form. かっといた = 'bought in advance'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a verb means 'if that is the case', and advice follows. とおで するなら = 'if you're going on a long trip'.
